newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan party pact sidesteps key issue--EPA minister.
newsitem.headline: Japan party pact sidesteps key issue--EPA minister.

text.p: A loose policy alliance among the Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) and its two former coalition partners failed to touch on the key issue of whether control of fiscal policy should be separated from control of the financial industry, Economic Planning Agency (EPA) Minister Shusei Tanaka said on Friday.

The LDP, the Social Democrats and the tiny Sakigake party on Thursday formalised the policy pact, including a pledge to present to parliament's regular session next year a bill to reform of the Finance Ministry, which now holds both functions.
But the agreement did not specify details of the reforms.
